A [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|'''GR-75 Medium transport''']] was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to take a small [[Army/Legends|army]] from [[Krant]] to its [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the mission's events during that time period.</ref> In transit, rumors that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was on his way spread among the crews. The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] landed on [[Hanoon|Geddes]] and discharged a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Heavy troopers]], three [[T1-B hovertank]]s, and three [[Energy pummel/Legends|Pummels]], along with the army's leaders, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was also a passenger. The army, along with a force of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], raided the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] research facility on Geddes and stole the ancient [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] [[Vor'Na'Tu]]. On their way back to the transport, they were ambushed by Darth Vader. Shen-Jon sacrificed himself to allow Organa to escape on the transport.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The transport appears in the second Princess Leia campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as the "Landed Rebel Transport" model. It also appears in the pre-mission video. The game's [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], released a week before the game itself, was the first source to mention the ship.
